title: Sun, Moon and Rising sign
description: The three points that explain most of your personality in a birth chart.

pages.title: Who you are
pages.text: Your Sun sign is the one everyone knows. It shows your core, your drive and the way you shine.

pages.title: What you feel
pages.text: The Moon shows your emotions, what calms you down and what makes you feel at home.

pages.title: How you appear
pages.text: The rising sign is your first impression and the way you introduce yourself to the world.

pages.title: Three pieces, one personality
pages.text: Sun, Moon and rising sign blend together. That is why two people with the same sign can be so different.
